tests.adaptation: Native explicit dependency registration replaces Node ModuleJob graph introspection. Unrelated files cause zero replacement, linked dependency triggers replacement once, and framework changes request host restart without replacing the plugin.

tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: replaces a plugin when a linked dependency changes, excluding framework modules

tests.title: classifies dependency cycles and excludes builtins and unchanged leaf modules
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: classifies dependency cycles and excludes builtins and unchanged leaf modules
tests.adaptation: RegisterDependencies declares direct native edges for plugin and non-plugin nodes. Iterative closure follows transitive edges, terminates cycles, and selects exactly changed+parent while leaf/cycles remain untouched; a changed cycle selects each member once. Node builtin jobs/accepted/declined cache sets are replaced by explicit framework exclusions and observable native replacement selection.

tests.title: rejects failed replacement activation and restores the prior plugin
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: rejects failed replacement activation and restores the prior plugin
tests.adaptation: Failed candidate activation restores original plugin identity/mounts and emits no success; real async DLL candidate additionally proves both entry/direct fibers, latest entry options, closed candidate resources, subsequent valid replacement and collected load contexts.

tests.title: leaves disposed child instances to their replacing parent
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: leaves disposed child instances to their replacing parent
tests.adaptation: Actual old child fiber belongs to disposing entry parent. New entry and independent fiber activate; disposed child is not recreated; raw entry config remains unchanged.

tests.title: invalidates a disabled module without activating it
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: invalidates a disabled module without activating it
tests.adaptation: Disabled Loader entry retains null Fiber and zero candidate activation while its explicit native module notification is processed.

tests.title: does not disturb an unchanged runtime after an earlier replacement fails
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: does not disturb an unchanged runtime after an earlier replacement fails
tests.adaptation: A failing first Loader replacement restores its runtime and prevents later registered replacement; independent untouched runtime remains mounted exactly once.

tests.title: restores the prior plugin when the replacement does not export a plugin
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: restores the prior plugin when the replacement does not export a plugin
tests.adaptation: CLR validates the explicit IClrPluginModule/type before stopping live fibers. Preparation rejection preserves running code, but this differs from source invalid export normalization after teardown.
missingAssertions: Exact null-plugin DLL fixture rejects and preserves old fiber/plugin identity. Original invalid-export normalization tears down then remounts (apply twice); CLR validates entry CreatePlugin result before teardown (apply once). This explicit platform adaptation remains partial, not an original assertion pass.

tests.title: reports a missing entry base URL without changing the running module
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: reports a missing entry base URL without changing the running module
tests.adaptation: Node relative entry import requires an ambient entry base URL. CLR mapping instead requires a registered absolute bundle root and explicit contained assembly path; unknown/external entries reject before load. Linked native boundary test does not execute the Node no-base-URL assertion.

tests.title: ignores framework entries and reports unresolved entry modules
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: ignores framework entries and reports unresolved entry modules
tests.adaptation: TrackLoader scans current actual Loader entries with an explicit non-loading native locator. Missing mapping warns with original exception identity, framework and uncached entry fibers remain active, unknown GetLinked returns an empty array, and detached tracking emits no warnings. Native host supplies path resolution rather than Node loader introspection.

tests.title: leaves an entry alone when its cache is %s
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: leaves an entry alone when its cache is %s
tests.adaptation: Unregistered/non-plugin native nodes cannot start a replacement callback. Explicit RegisterModule is the CLR counterpart of a cached valid plugin namespace; unrelated notifications assert zero replacement. No Node cache-layout inference is performed.

tests.title: leaves an entry alone when its cache is %s
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe

tests.title: restores the CommonJS cache when an ESM replacement import fails
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: restores the CommonJS cache when an ESM replacement import fails
tests.adaptation: Node ESM/CommonJS cache objects are represented by ClrModuleResolver loaded leases. Missing DLL/type and rejected switch preserve the exact old IPlugin identity, exact old entry Fiber, and unchanged mount trace. CLR has one explicit lease table rather than two ambient JS caches; real native preparation failures verify rollback ownership.

tests.title: can replace a plugin that has an earlier activation failure
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: can replace a plugin that has an earlier activation failure
tests.adaptation: A real failed old Loader fiber is replaced by an active candidate exactly once.

tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: reports the original replacement failure when restoring the old plugin also fails
tests.adaptation: Real candidate and restoration both throw. Loader diagnostic receives restore failed, while the HMR caller receives the original replacement failed exception.

tests.title: waits for application readiness and applies profile, home and manifest changes
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: waits for application readiness and applies profile, home and manifest changes
tests.adaptation: Session owns boot readiness and accepts an external readiness gate. Real profile/home/manifest watches preserve current value until readiness, apply profile/home precedence, remove home effects through an empty patch, and hot-reconcile bundle selection. Native API is StartAsync with explicit resolver; no daemon is created.

tests.sourceTitle: applies configuration while a CLI operation holds the package writer lock
tests.adaptation: A real native package.json.cordis-lock FileStream held with FileShare.None remains held while automatic profile update reaches during-install. This is the native package-writer lock convention.

tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: ignores dependency-only manifest changes and reloads a changed bundle list
tests.adaptation: Exact root update count is zero after dependency-only edit, one after added bundle, still one after duplicate refresh; newly inserted disabled bundled entry exists.

tests.title: cancels queued reloads when the application exits before readiness
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: cancels queued reloads when the application exits before readiness
tests.adaptation: Owner disposal cancels an unresolved startup gate, completes without self-wait, and permits no queued module/config candidate activation. Closed native Context is no longer publicly readable, unlike JavaScript undefined service access.

tests.sourceTitle: reports unreadable inputs and recovers after the file is corrected
tests.adaptation: Replaces the patch file with a directory to create a real unreadable input, waits for diagnostic, restores exact original bytes, and verifies running value and bytes are preserved.

keyAssertions: await expect(ctx.plugin(Hmr, { root: [], ignored: [], debounce: 0 })).rejects.toThrow('Profile HMR requires application readiness')
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: rejects a profile launcher that omits application readiness
tests.adaptation: ProfileSession always constructs and owns its internal application-readiness gate. Omitting the optional external gate never omits boot readiness; the invalid independently installed JS Hmr+profileContext state is not representable by this native launcher API. Independent readiness test is linked, not counted as a rejection test.

tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: HMR exact config paths / stops searching when the filesystem root cannot be read
tests.adaptation: Small metadata-reader seam injects native UnauthorizedAccessException and DirectoryNotFoundException. Original error identities are retained; each missing-root search visits root exactly once and stops, including root itself as target.

tests.title: HMR exact config paths / releases registration after watcher %s fails
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: HMR exact config paths / releases registration after watcher %s fails
tests.adaptation: Constructor failure releases registration; activation failure closes the allocated native watcher once; corrected path can be registered and later runtime warning retains exception identity.

tests.title: HMR exact config paths / releases registration after watcher %s fails
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: HMR exact config paths / releases registration after watcher %s fails
tests.adaptation: FileSystemWatcher has synchronous EnableRaisingEvents activation instead of chokidar ready promise. Native initialization explicitly validates the named root after construction. The metadata-reader seam deterministically rejects this post-construction phase on both Windows and Linux, retaining original error identity; the allocated watcher closes once, registration frees, recovery and later warning are asserted. No OS-specific renamed-directory activation behavior is assumed.

tests.title: HMR exact config paths / closes a ready watcher when its context has already been disposed
keyAssertions:
await expect(watchConfig(ctx, join(dir, 'plugins.yml'), {}, () => {}))
      .rejects.toThrow('cannot create effect on inactive context')
tests.platform: Windows x64 .NET 10; native DLL cases require ordinary CLR, config/graph/queue mechanisms are AOT-safe
tests.sourceTitle: HMR exact config paths / closes a ready watcher when its context has already been disposed
tests.adaptation: Synchronous native factory reenters owning HMR disposal before returning allocated watcher. Start detects closed owner, closes new resource exactly once and rejects; this covers ownership race across native activation boundary without inventing an async ready phase.

Queue warns with config path then exact exception object, and next event runs for calls=2. Warning is structured as one formatted native string rather than JS printf arguments.

tests.title: classifyInstallFailure / names the run's end before reading its output, then the most specific code in the output
keyAssertions: expect(classifyInstallFailure({ log: '', cause: Object.assign(new Error('spawn pnpm ENOENT'), { code: 'ENOENT' }) })).toBe('pnpm-missing')
expect(classifyInstallFailure({ log: 'ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS  Ignored build scripts: node-pty' })).toBe('build-blocked')
expect(classifyInstallFailure({ log: 'npm error code E404\nnpm error 404 Not Found - GET https://registry/x' })).toBe('not-found')
expect(classifyInstallFailure({ log: 'ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION  No matching version found for x@9' })).toBe('no-matching-version')
expect(classifyInstallFailure({ log: 'ENOSPC: no space left on device, write' })).toBe('disk-full')
expect(classifyInstallFailure({ log: 'ERR_PNPM_META_FETCH_FAIL  GET https://registry/x: request to https://registry/x failed, reason: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND registry' })).toBe('network')
expect(classifyInstallFailure({ log: 'ERR_PNPM_FETCH_502  GET https://registry/x: Bad Gateway' })).toBe('network')
expect(classifyInstallFailure({ log: 'fatal: unable to access https://github.com/a/b/: Could not resolve host' })).toBe('network')
expect(classifyInstallFailure({ log: 'exited with 1', cause: new Error('no code') })).toBe('unknown')

Profiles.Preview retains raw expressions without evaluating them.
